args.sql_query:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_listings,
    SUM(CASE WHEN host_listing_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS listings_multi_host,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN host_listing_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
